fact: The 2024 Boletim Estatístico sobre Proteção Social de Cabo Verde 2021-2023, compiled by INE with INPS, CNPS, FICASE, IEFP and IGT, publishes social-protection statistics for 2021-2023, including active insured persons of the INPS by regime and sex.
title: Boletim Estatístico sobre Proteção Social de Cabo Verde, 2021-2023
